name: Lightbox
description:
Pictures at full size in a dialog: previous and next (← →, or a swipe on touch), zoom
(+ − and 0 to fit) where a zoomed picture pans by dragging or scrolling, an optional strip
of thumbnails and actions for the current picture. Each picture starts fitted.
signature: ({ images, index: indexProp, defaultIndex, onIndexChange, open: openProp, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, thumbnails, actions, zoomSteps, locale, labels, }: LightboxProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions for the current picture at the end of the footer: download, open the original.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The first picture shown when uncontrolled. Default 0.

props.name: index
props.description: The picture shown. Pair with `onIndexChange` to control it.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ previous: string; next: string; zoomIn: string; zoomOut: string; fit: string; fitted: string; alreadyFitted: string; largest: string; position: (index: number, total: number) => string; thumbnails: string; show: (alt: string) => string; }> | undefined

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the zero-based index to show, from previous/next, ← →, a swipe or a thumbnail (wrapping at the ends).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes, including keyboard dismissal and outside interaction.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: thumbnails
props.description: Show a strip of thumbnails under the picture when there are several. Default true.

props.name: zoomSteps
props.description: Zoom steps after "fit", as multiples of the fitted width. Default 1.5, 2 and 3.
